approval_requests_decision_fields_consis.name: approval_requests_decision_fields_consistent
approval_requests_decision_fields_consis.value:
(
        ("approval_requests"."status" = 'PENDING' AND "approval_requests"."decided_by_user_id" IS NULL AND "approval_requests"."decided_at" IS NULL AND "approval_requests"."decision_remarks" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("approval_requests"."status" IN ('APPROVED', 'REJECTED') AND "approval_requests"."decided_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "approval_requests"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL AND "approval_requests"."decision_remarks" IS NOT NULL)
      )

invoice_email_deliveries_failure_reason_.name: invoice_email_deliveries_failure_reason_consistent
invoice_email_deliveries_failure_reason_.value:
(
        ("invoice_email_deliveries"."status" = 'SENT' AND "invoice_email_deliveries"."failure_reason" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("invoice_email_deliveries"."status" = 'FAILED' AND "invoice_email_deliveries"."failure_reason" IS NOT NULL)
      )
